title: Welcome to the Real World: How You Live in Your Own Simulation of Reality — and How We Can Still Share a World. A Theory of Persistence, Emergence, Learning, and Correctable Intelligence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v22.1 adds a single front door to the core dynamic: CORE.md states the vortex loop on one page (ledger, ratchet, vortex, speed, network, and the boundaries that cannot be dropped), and formalization/ebe-core/EbECore.lean collects and audits the 37 machine-checked results that carry it, usable as a Lean dependency. It also adds a network ledger separating creation from transfer inside the vortex. The v22.0 universal core and intelligent-system specialization are retained unchanged. The release title uses ‘simulation of reality’ to mean the internal model through which a system experiences and acts in the world, not a claim that reality itself is simulated. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open. The original repository material is dual-licensed under CC BY 4.0 OR Apache-2.0 as documented in DUAL-LICENSING.md; CC BY 4.0 is supplied here as the single Zenodo archival metadata value because the GitHub-Zenodo metadata path accepts one license value.
